verdict.line: You lose if Camille gets an E (Hookshot) knockup off a wall into empowered Q before level 7; you win once Warmog's and Heartsteel complete and her burst stops being lethal.

brief.thesis: Camille's kit is built to punish exactly what Mundo lacks before level 11: a dash, a stun, or burst damage to answer her wall-assisted E (Hookshot) knockup and recast-delayed Q (Precision Protocol). Mundo has no tools to contest that window, so the matchup is measured as Camille-favored (47.3% Mundo win rate over 184 games) even though his percent-health Q poke and passive sustain let him farm through it and take over once his health items complete.

theirWindow.when: she's near a wall with E and Q up
theirWindow.what: She can Hookshot (E) off the wall for the knockup, land an empowered Q (Precision Protocol) recast for bonus damage, and finish with W (Tactical Sweep) for the slow and heal. Back off the wall-adjacent side of lane and don't let her get a free E engage.

yourWindow.when: her E is on cooldown (16-12s) after use
yourWindow.what: She has no gap-close or knockup until it's back up. Shove the wave hard with Q (Infected Cleaver) and take the trades she offers with autos, since she can't force a kill-threat all-in.

E unlocks, R adds all-in kill threat

Spirit Visage regen buries her damage

start.why: Doran's Shield + Health Potion wins this start 51.1% over 137 games because it directly answers her empowered-auto poke pattern before she has a knockup to punish you for standing still.

boots.why: 60.2% win rate over 108 games; the extra move speed matters more than tenacity here since your job is staying off the walls she needs for E (Hookshot), not shrugging off CC.

core.why: Raw max-health scales both your Q (Infected Cleaver) damage and your passive regen, and this is the highest-win-rate first item at 68% over 25 games in this matchup.
Continues the health-stacking plan so your percent-health Q keeps scaling while you out-tank her burst windows.
Boosts the self-healing from your passive and R (Sadism) right as her early lane pressure runs out, closing out the 68% win-rate path.

situational.when: you're ahead on the wave and want more wave-clear and dueling AD instead of a third defensive item
camille is building crit or you need the grievous wounds to shut down her W (Tactical Sweep) healing
you're getting outdueled early and need the armor and healing cut sooner than a full Thornmail

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs off the trades she's willing to take and stacks bonus health, directly countering the fact that she has lane and solo-kill advantage on paper.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the highest win-rate pairing at 47.8% over a 39.2% pick rate; Flash is the cleanest way to dodge her E (Hookshot) knockup and W (Tactical Sweep) cone, and Teleport recovers the tempo you lose in a lane where she holds early priority.

playing.title: Farm with Q, not autos
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this lane is to lean on Q (Infected Cleaver) to farm rather than trade autos. Its percent-max-health damage scales regardless of items, so use it to poke and last-hit from range instead of walking up into her empowered-auto trades.

playing.title: Respect the W telegraph
playing.detail: W (Tactical Sweep) fires after a delay and the outer half of the cone deals extra damage, slows, and heals her. Watch for the windup and step out of that outer band rather than eating it at melee range.

playing.title: Track wall proximity
playing.detail: E (Hookshot) only lets her knock you up if she's near a wall (800 range to latch on). If there's no wall within that range, her engage is just a dash with no knockup, so you can hold trades more aggressively.

playing.title: Trade low with E up
playing.detail: E (Masochism) scales your bonus AD off missing health, so your best damage windows are when you're already chunked. Pair it with W (Burning Agony) for the sustained burn once you're committed to a fight.

playing.title: Pop R if her ultimate lands
playing.detail: R (Hextech Ultimatum) anchors whoever she targets to the area, so if she pulls you in you can't walk away regardless. Use R (Sadism) immediately for the move speed and health regen to out-sustain the fight rather than trying to disengage.

playing.title: Shove on her E cooldown
playing.detail: Her E (Hookshot) is 16/15/14/13/12s on cooldown; the moment she uses it to reposition or farm, push the wave hard with Q since she has no knockup to punish your push.

playing.title: Play for the item breakpoint
playing.detail: This lane is measured as hers through level 10; don't force all-ins before Warmog's and Heartsteel are both up. Once they land, your sustain tank stats start beating her burst outright.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers above are measured from live Dr. Mundo vs Camille games on the current patch via OP.GG; the ability readings, timing windows, and tactical advice are this coach's own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Camille is a bad matchup. Do not pick Dr. Mundo if Camille is picked. Avoid her (W) while using [Q] to farm lane.
